# Truckee Snowbotics

> FTC Team #32587 — a student-run FIRST Tech Challenge robotics team based at Tahoe-Truckee High School in Truckee, California. Founded 2025. Fiscally sponsored by Hack Club, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit (EIN: 81-2908499).

We design, build, and program competitive robots for the FIRST Tech Challenge (FTC) competition circuit in the Northern Nevada region. The current season is 2026–27: BIOBUZZ presented by RTX.

## Pages

- [Home](https://snowbotics.org/): Team overview, outreach, and donation options.
- [Information](https://snowbotics.org/information/): Details about FTC, how to join the team, and our nonprofit structure.
- [Gallery](https://snowbotics.org/gallery/): Photos from the build floor, competitions, and events.
- [Season](https://snowbotics.org/season/): Live stream of the events we compete in, the event schedule, and our current robot.
- [Sponsors](https://snowbotics.org/sponsors/): Current sponsors, donation info, and how to become a sponsor.
- [Contact](https://snowbotics.org/contact/): Contact form and sponsorship inquiries.
- [About](https://snowbotics.org/about/): Meet the students, mentors and alumni of the team.
- [Terms & Photo Policy](https://snowbotics.org/terms/): How photos are used, how to submit one, and how to request a takedown.
- [Privacy Policy](https://snowbotics.org/privacy/): What data the site collects and which third-party services it uses.
